Homebrew is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2018 to 2019.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (2).

Most recently: [home](@/work/home.md): home directory; [bcnode-extra-scripts](@/work/bcnode-extra-scripts.md): BC Extra Scripts (DX).

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Homebrew: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Homebrew to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
